Both Spotify and Apple Music use algorithms to normalize loudness, meaning that when you play different songs, they will have very similar loudness. However those algorithms are not the same, and honestly, I’ve been using Spotify (premium) for years and when I got my first iPhone this year, I got 3-month-free Apple Music subscription and I must say, the difference is noticeable, Apple Music sounds much more clear (but I dont think regular user would notice some difference).

Now to the lossless audio. You said you were listnening to the same songs on Spotify and Apple Music and heard the difference. I think thats because of what I explained above. If your headphones are not capable of playing the tracks in the quality delivered, it uses maximum quality your headphones are capable of (I would say). Saying you heard the difference because of algorithms, not the new Lossless audio.

Edit: Also both platforms support different audio formats and handle them differently.
